name: @brentmzey/nfl-superbowl-predictions-client
description: Strictly typed, validated, retrying PocketBase client with JDBI-style query templates for the NFL Super Bowl predictions database.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --external pocketbase && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: bun run test:coverage && bun run typecheck && bun run build
